nodes.label: Industrial Telemetry Dark Color Palette (Deep Charcoal + Safety Orange)
nodes.rationale: Deep Charcoal (#1A1C1E) foundation provides blacked-out dashboard feel ensuring vibrant status colors pop without visual fatigue. Safety Orange (#F97316) reserved for CTAs, active alerts, critical navigation — mimics high-visibility gear on industrial sites. Reduces eye strain during long shifts.

nodes.label: Industrial Telemetry Dual-Font Strategy
nodes.rationale: Inter for interface labels/headlines (legible at small scales, neutral professional tone). JetBrains Mono for hard data: VIN numbers, GPS coordinates, timestamps, fleet IDs — monospaced columns prevent errors reading similar chars like 0 and O. High-density logic with tight line heights.

nodes.label: High Density Maximum Context Layout Philosophy
nodes.rationale: 12-column fluid grid for desktop, 12px gutters for tight packing, 24px page margins to maximize internal real estate for maps and data tables. Compact vertical rhythm: 4px between related data points, 12-16px between functional groups. Mobile collapses to single column with horizontal scrolling rather than hiding columns.
